claims.claim: Costco's hot dog and soda combo has cost $1.50 since 1985; fiscal year 2025 marked the offering's 40th anniversary.
Costco sold a record 245.1 million hot dog and soda combos in fiscal year 2025, per figures from its January 2026 annual shareholder meeting.
When then-CEO Craig Jelinek proposed raising the combo price to $1.75, co-founder Jim Sinegal replied: 'If you raise the effing hot dog, I will kill you. Figure it out.'
Costco collected $5.323 billion in membership fees in fiscal 2025, with US and Canada member renewal rates of 92.3%.
Adjusted for inflation, the 1985-priced $1.50 combo would cost more than $4 today.

scenes.narration: Costco loses money on its most famous product. On purpose. A hot dog and soda: one fifty. Unchanged for forty years.
